newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hoyts says on track for 96/97 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Hoyts says on track for 96/97 forecasts.

text.p: Hoyts Cinema Ltd said on Wednesday it expected that earnings would not be less than the 1996 prospectus forecasts.
"For the 1996/97 financial year, we expect that earnings will not be less than the initial public offering (IPO) prospectus forecasts," Hoyts said.
"Hoyts has a very positive near-term outlook and attractive longer term growth prospects," it said.
Earlier, Hoyts announced plans to raise A$95 million through a rights issue to fund expansion into Latin America and retire debt.

In its prospectus, Hoyts forecast a A$22 million net profit for the year to June 30, 1997. The group listed in August 1996 after it offered 50 million shares or 22.5 percent of the capital at A$2 each to raise A$100 million.
Hoyts reported a net profit of A$13.1 million for the six months ended December 31, 1996. At 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT), Hoyts shares were two cents up at A$2.70.

"The Board and management are committed to the objective of continuing the profitable growth of Hoyts Cinemas and are confident that this capital raising will position the company to take full advantage of very profitable investment opportunities," Hoyts said.
